about: Forgejo/git verifier verbs and the per-student repo seed builder (A22). The service runs them with its own Forgejo admin login, so a student can't post a pass by hand. Every `repo` argument must be the checking student's own ({user}/...); the runner refuses anything else.

pr_exists.does: a pull request from head into base (default main); state open, merged or open_or_merged (default); title starts with title_prefix (case-insensitive)

pr_files.does: that pull request changes exactly these files

pr_file_contains.does: the file at the pull request's head commit contains the text or matches the regex (multiline); absent: true inverts

file_contains.does: the file on a branch, tag or commit contains the text or matches the regex; absent: true inverts

no_direct_push.does: every commit on the branch came from the seed or through a merged pull request into it

answer_names_commit.does: the file names the short hash (7+ hex characters) and the author of the oldest commit on search.branch whose diff adds a line equal to search.text in search.path

forgejo-repo.does: creates {user}/NAME under the student's own account (the student owns it, so has write access) and plays the plan's commits and branches into it through the Forgejo API; reset deletes and re-creates it
